name: Mask and Weight Filtering for Patch Points
definition: Applies a binary mask $w_j$ to rule out outliers during the pulling step, and a scalar weight $\eta_j$ to focus the network on the most important point $p'_j$ on the patch surface.
summary: Mask and Weight Filtering for Patch Points refines Signed Distance Field optimization by applying a binary mask to exclude outliers and a scalar weight to prioritize points with strong gradient alignment.
